in_marathi.name: Jugesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jugesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jugesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jug' meaning 'Lord' and 'Ish' meaning 'of the Universe'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Jupiters, who represents strength, power, and prosperity.
